Internal absolute and multi-link resolution acceptance, linked-source limits/PAX/submodule and executable/write-destination preservation beyond this prompt-side inventory remain covered only by separate code-side tests where actually executed.
follow_up: Build/verify must retain existing refusal suite and exercise consistency/limit boundaries against linked accepted paths. Inventory omissions are not passes.

criteria.text: A selected direct file link or a selected file inside a linked folder sends the final Git-visible regular file's exact bytes under the authored path, as a regular archive entry with mode 0600.
`pdd test --files` shows each linked file as `authored/path -> canonical/target` with its byte size, offline.

Outside targets, broken links, loops, secret link names, secret target names and targets that are not Git-visible are refused before upload; the message names the link and its target and explains why.

Source metadata, except the strict no-link bindings inventory, and raw preparation/reference reads use the same safe link policy; reference-only source stays unselected and relative Markdown dependencies keep the authored linked path as their base.

Link resolution and bytes belong to one consistent snapshot; source SHA, archive ordering/PAX, limits, other privacy/type/submodule refusals, prepared output destinations and executable/write-target refusals retain their existing guarantees.
